title: I’ve joined Anthropic
summary: Andrej Karpathy, a renowned AI researcher and educator (famous for his deep learning courses), has announced joining Anthropic, the AI safety company behind Claude. This is a significant industry move as Karpathy previously co-founded OpenAI and led Autopilot development at Tesla.
problem_solved: Major AI talent movement that could accelerate Anthropic's research and development capabilities while bringing a prominent educator and researcher to the AI safety field.
why_valuable: Karpathy is one of the most influential figures in AI whose move to Anthropic signals potential shifts in the AI landscape and could strengthen AI safety research efforts.
